proposal.summary: A proof-of-concept exploit for Source Engine (CS:GO and other games) BuildIDs demonstrates arbitrary code execution on the tested macOS target by writing a payload to /tmp/hl2_relaunch that injects shell commands.
proposal.affected_product: Source Engine (CS:GO BuildID: 4937372, TF2 BuildID: 4871679, Garry's Mod BuildID: 4803834, Half Life 2 BuildID: 4233302)

AV.quote: A proof-of-concept exploit for Source Engine (CS:GO and other games) BuildIDs demonstrates arbitrary code execution on the tested macOS target by writing a payload to /tmp/hl2_relaunch that injects shell commands.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm and reproduce the write-to-/tmp/hl2_relaunch behavior against the listed build IDs, identify the vulnerable code path that accepts or constructs the relaunch payload, and develop a patch to validate/escape inputs and/or restrict file write locations.
